name: EvoSafe held-out seven-role EA evaluation benchmark
description: Independently constructed evaluation set for the frozen EA inference v1 detector. Programs and labels were written before the detector was run on any of them; labels are locked by labels.lock.json.
labeling_guidelines: A role is positive iff the source file itself implements it: inline logic, a helper defined in the file, or a callable defined in the file and supplied to an engine, registry, or dispatch table.
Behaviour hidden inside an external framework or unresolved call is negative; configuration values such as num_generations are not termination logic.
Choosing survivors (e.g. min/sort to decide what is removed or kept) may make both selection and replacement positive.
Ground truth is human semantic judgment and may use names and docstrings; the detector is not expected to rely on names alone.

positive_rationale.population: population is a list of bit-list genomes iterated each generation.
positive_rationale.selection: Scored genomes are sorted and the top four kept as parents.
positive_rationale.mutation: A random bit of each child is flipped.
positive_rationale.crossover: Children join a prefix of one parent and suffix of the next.
positive_rationale.replacement: population is reassigned to parents + children.
positive_rationale.termination: while best < 6 stops on reaching the optimum.
